# Repository metadata

The GitHub settings for `coderscantina/holocron`. GitHub keeps them outside the repo, so this file is the source to apply them from.

## Description

Self-hosted web analytics for Umami operators. Keep your Umami tracker and history, see how today compares with a usual weekday, explore with nested filters, watch replays. One Rust binary with embedded SQLite and DuckDB.

## Topics

`web-analytics`, `self-hosted`, `analytics`, `umami`, `privacy`, `cookieless`, `session-replay`, `google-analytics-alternative`, `rust`, `duckdb`, `sqlite`

## Apply

```bash
gh repo edit coderscantina/holocron \
  --description "Self-hosted web analytics for Umami operators. Keep your Umami tracker and history, see how today compares with a usual weekday, explore with nested filters, watch replays. One Rust binary with embedded SQLite and DuckDB." \
  --add-topic web-analytics,self-hosted,analytics,umami,privacy,cookieless,session-replay,google-analytics-alternative,rust,duckdb,sqlite \
  --enable-discussions
```

## Social preview

GitHub has no API for it. Upload `.github/social-preview.png` under Settings, General, Social preview. Regenerate it from `scripts/social-preview.html`.
